div.div:
Constraints
(1) every wagon: one run, one lane
(2) a wagon's run carries its goods type
(3) one goods type per used run; used runs first, none empty
(4) consecutive runs have different goods
(5)–(7) FIFO: along the keys, the runs of the wagons
in a lane do not decrease (ρ = highest run so far)
(8) T_p leaves in the run of its last wagon
(9) … and not before T_(p−1)
(10) a wagon of a later train in a run before D(p)
is in the buffer when T_p leaves
(11) h = a · z, exact (Σ_ℓ h = a, h ≤ z)
(12) lane capacity right before every departure
(13) lane used ⇔ it holds wagons
(14) lanes ordered by their number of wagons
(15) sum of (12) over all lanes — implied, stronger LP
(16) optional spread S: F(k) ≤ r(i) ≤ F(k) + S,
a train within S + 1 consecutive runs

text.tspan: (1) every wagon: one run, one lane
(2) a wagon's run carries its goods type
(3) one goods type per used run; used runs first, none empty
(5)–(7) FIFO: along the keys, the runs of the wagons
in a lane do not decrease (ρ = highest run so far)
(8) T_p leaves in the run of its last wagon
(10) a wagon of a later train in a run before D(p)
is in the buffer when T_p leaves
(11) h = a · z, exact (Σ_ℓ h = a, h ≤ z)
(12) lane capacity right before every departure
(14) lanes ordered by their number of wagons
(15) sum of (12) over all lanes — implied, stronger LP
(16) optional spread S: F(k) ≤ r(i) ≤ F(k) + S,
a train within S + 1 consecutive runs

div.div:
Three facts (proved in mip-model.md)
1 Inside a run the wagons are loaded in extraction order (by key).
2 A FIFO lane never blocks ⇔ its run numbers do not decrease along the keys.
3 Lane weight only grows between departures: check capacity right before each one.
So the model only chooses a run and a lane for every wagon.

text.tspan: 1 Inside a run the wagons are loaded in extraction order (by key).
2 A FIFO lane never blocks ⇔ its run numbers do not decrease along the keys.
3 Lane weight only grows between departures: check capacity right before each
So the model only chooses a run and a lane for every wagon.
